'''''Ravtin 2''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] serving the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. The ship was part of [[Ravtin group]] which participated in the [[Skirmish at Outpost D-34]]. Ravtin 2, along with [[Ravtin 1]] and [[Ravtin 3|3]] as well as [[Tough group]], attempted to stop Imperial forces from capturing [[Onece 3]] of [[Onece group]] which carried their fellow rebels. Both shuttle groups were unsuccessful and were all destroyed in the process.

==Behind the scenes==
These ships only appear in the Hard difficulty on Battle 1 mission 1.
